mapper.sql: t.id, t.title, t.description, t.scope, t.project_id AS projectId, p.project_name AS projectName, t.category, t.latest_version AS latestVersion, t.latest_version_id AS latestVersionId, t.published_version_count AS publishedVersionCount, CASE WHEN #{globalManager} = TRUE OR (t.scope = 'PROJECT' AND current_member.project_role IN ('OWNER', 'MAINTAINER')) THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lab_experiment_template_version draft_version WHERE draft_version.template_id = t.id AND draft_version.status = 'DRAFT') ELSE NULL END AS hasDraft, t.created_by AS createdBy, creator.username AS createdByName, t.create_time AS createTime, t.update_time AS updateTime
